notes: image::gif: Decode/DecodeAll/DecodeConfig with Go's validation and leniencies plus explicit Limits; byte-identical Encode (Options: NumColors/Quantizer/Drawer) and EncodeAll; zero Config is None; failed encodes write nothing; Decode returns the first frame as Paletted rather than image.Image

Decode.note: Returns the concrete Paletted first frame instead of image.Image (Rust shape: the dynamic type is what Go returns). Default Limits (64M pixels per frame, 256M pixels total, 65536 frames, 1 GiB input) reject larger inputs that Go accepts; they do not change results on Go's own testdata, and Limits can be raised or disabled.

DecodeAll.note: Default Limits (64M pixels per frame, 256M pixels total, 65536 frames, 1 GiB input) reject larger inputs that Go accepts; they do not change results on Go's own testdata, and Limits can be raised or disabled.

DecodeConfig.note: Default Limits (64M pixels per frame, 256M pixels total, 65536 frames, 1 GiB input) reject larger inputs that Go accepts; they do not change results on Go's own testdata, and Limits can be raised or disabled.

Encode.note: the options argument is Option, Go's nil *Options

GIF.Config.note: Option<Config>: None is Go's zero Config

GIF.Disposal.note: Option<Vec<u8>>: None is Go's nil Disposal
